settings.question: How do I know which skin type I am?
settings.answer: Wash with a gentle cleanser, pat dry and wait an hour without applying anything. Tight all over means dry, shine on the nose and forehead only means combination, shine everywhere means oily. If it stings or reddens easily, read our sensitive range first, whatever your type.

settings.question: Is the face oil too rich for oily skin?
settings.answer: Not usually. Rosehip and squalane sit close to the skin's own sebum, so oily skin often makes less once it stops being stripped. Start with two drops at night only.

settings.question: My skin changes with the seasons. Do I need two routines?
settings.answer: Keep the cleanser and serum all year and swap only the last step: the whipped cream from spring to autumn, the balm when the heating comes on.

settings.question: Can I use bakuchiol and vitamin C together?
settings.answer: Yes. Bakuchiol is gentle enough to share a routine with vitamin C, though we still suggest vitamin C in the morning and bakuchiol at night so each has its own time to work.

settings.question: Why don't you use synthetic retinol?
settings.answer: We formulate with bakuchiol and rosehip oil, which smooth texture without the dryness many people get from retinol. If you already use a prescription retinoid, keep it and skip our bakuchiol serum.

settings.question: Are your essential oils safe for sensitive skin?
settings.answer: The face range is fragrance-free. Only the body balms carry essential oils, under 0.5%, and every one is named on the label.

settings.question: Can I return a jar I've already opened?
settings.answer: Yes, within 30 days, even half used. If something doesn't agree with your skin, send it back and we refund in full or swap it for a different formula.

settings.question: How long does a jar keep once it's open?
settings.answer: Look for the small open-jar symbol on the base: 6M means six months, 12M a year. Our balms hold no water, so they keep their full 12 months with clean, dry fingers or the spatula.

settings.question: What happens to the products you get back?
settings.answer: Unopened returns go back to stock. Opened ones can't be resold, so they are emptied and the glass and tins are cleaned and recycled.

settings.question: When will my order arrive?
settings.answer: Orders placed before 1 pm leave the same working day. Standard delivery takes 2–4 days and is free from $75; next-day delivery is $9.

settings.question: Is the packaging plastic-free?
settings.answer: The jars are glass or aluminium, the lids are aluminium and the box is recycled card held with paper tape. The only plastic is the pump on the cleanser, which you can send back to us.
